summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K furnishing its amended Articles of Association, effective June 16, 2026. The filing updates the company's name, objects, share capital, authorized capital increases (up to DKK 6.6M without pre-emption rights through March 2029), and warrant programs for employees. There are no transactional terms, prices, premiums, or board actions related to acquisitions, divestitures, or other special situations. This is a routine corporate governance update by a foreign private issuer. No deal mechanics or regulatory clocks are implicated. What to watch: this is purely administrative; no event-driven angle.
